_readme: AGENT-ADDABLE boss. Bosses cycle by level (sorted file order); on each full cycle the composition rule REMIXES in patterns borrowed from other bosses and tightens intervals (Isaac-style, see BossCatalog.compose_for_level). enemy_base = id from data/enemies/ (sprite/stat base). pattern types are code-backed modules (new modules require code — flagged exception): radial_burst (count, proj_speed, damage, interval), aimed_volley (count, spread_deg, proj_speed, damage, interval), charge_dash (windup_sec, dash_speed, dash_sec, interval), summon_minions (count, interval).
